messages:
emma: Heads-up: BlueMeridian is asking for an 18mo Dedicated commit (H100-only) with a POC window that includes burst. They want an upfront pricing guarantee for burst during POC.
rory: what burst profile are they asking for?
emma: They suggested baseline 50 H100 slots, burst to 200 slots (4x) but only for short traffic spikes. POC expected 8 weeks.
lina: finance: baseline discounts of 30% for an 18mo whole-cluster commit is within reason iff ARR > $750k. For burst we normally allow max 15% promo discount for POC.
akash: engineering: H100-only simplifies kernel selection but 4x burst means we'll need both autoscale headroom and prewarmed nodes. Prep time at least 3 weeks to build prewarm images and test autoscaler. Also need model pinning.
emma: customer is pushing for 20% off burst during POC and wants the burst discount applied to true-up billing if they convert.
mike: deal desk: we can't promise POC burst guarantee that persists post-conversion unless it's in the contract. We can do temporary POC pricing with an explicit expiry clause.
legal: add DPA and data residency section; they require SOC2 + a signed DPA before any data movement. Also want to include a PO/INVOICE acceptance clause for monthly true-ups.
rory: success criteria from SE: latency p50 < 100ms, sustained 500 qps baseline, cold-start < 20ms after KV warm. If we meet this in POC they'll move to conversion.
lina: finance counter-proposal: 30% off baseline + 10% off burst during POC if commit >= $800k ARR. If ARR < $800k, then 20% baseline, 10% burst. Also require monthly true-up and an escrow clause for usage disputes.
emma: customer asked for price protection (no increase in unit rates for 12 months after conversion). can we do that?
mike: price protection ok only if signed MSA + 18mo commit and minimum monthly utilization threshold included. Otherwise no.
akash: engineering note: to honor a 4x burst we need a temporary soft-cap on concurrent model variants and an autoscale guardrail. We'll need a ticket to eng-runtime to schedule load tests.
emma: I'll push customer's ask and the finance counter. Also confirm they can sign DPA quickly.
legal: we'll draft the POC appendix, DPA, and the burst-expiry language: "POC burst pricing applies only to the POC period and will revert to standard committed rates on conversion unless explicitly stated in amendment."
rory: SE will own verification runs; plan to run canary + 24h soak at target QPS before sign-off.
lina: finance wants an estimated monthly cashflow table for SOW. emma, please get them to commit to projected monthly usage.
emma: will ask and report back. tagging @akash to confirm availability for 3-week prep starting 2026-05-10.
akash: I can allocate time week of 2026-05-10 but need eng-runtime ticket before EOD.
emma: thanks all. I'll post SOW draft and the proposed pricing grid here when ready. :spiral_calendar:
